register_chat_template_fallback_path: register a fallback chat template path for a given model type in the vLLM registry
get_chat_template_fallback_path: get the fallback chat template path for a model type and tokenizer name from the registry
build_chat_template_registry: build a chat template fallback registry mapping model types to Jinja template paths for vLLM
test_get_chat_template_fallback_path: test the get_chat_template_fallback_path function with various model types and tokenizer names
review_register_chat_template_fallback_p: review the register_chat_template_fallback_path function for overwriting existing template registrations
